topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I found a time capsule today, buried in the backyard, a small box under a now gnarled and old oak tree. The lid was corroded, whispering of a forgotten past. Inside, the items were an odd mix of trivialities—tickets from a long-gone fair, a faded photograph, a worn book of poetry. Each piece seemed to carry with it a silent story, a breath of a life once lived. The air felt different as I held these remnants, as if the weight of time had settled around me, heavy and cool. I wonder now who buried it, if they intended to return, or if, like me, they too were left to uncover a piece of themselves they didn’t know was missing.
